functions.name: list-down-payers
functions.description: List payers reported as temporarily down, including the provider's status and transaction-percentage statistic when supplied.

lookbackHours.description: Optional number of whole hours for the report's lookback window, mapped to checkForLastNumberOfHours. Omit to use the provider's unspecified default window; null is not accepted. Supported range is subject to provider validation.

id.description: Opaque payer code used as this record's identifier and to relate it to the payer directory.

name.description: Provider's payer display name; omitted or null when supplied that way.

status.description: Exact provider status text from this report, without translating it into other status categories.

providerPayerId.description: Additional provider payerID value, distinct from the payer code; opaque and omitted or null when supplied that way.

transactionPercentage.description: Unscaled numeric transPercentage reported by the provider. The denominator, reporting population, and success/failure interpretation are unspecified; no 0–100 range or failure-rate meaning is asserted. Omitted or null means unspecified.

items.description: One provider-reported temporary-down payer and its supplied statistics.
Provider-reported temporary-down-payer records for the requested or default report window; empty when no statuses are found.

FunctionOutput_pverify_listdownpayers.description: One temporary-down-payer report, preserving provider order and supplied values.

tags.instructions: Use this for the provider's temporary-down-payer report; use `list-payer-statuses` for all operational status categories. No payer ID is needed. Optionally choose a lookback in whole hours; omit it for the provider's default report window. Returns one provider page with no continuation. The transaction percentage is provider-reported: its denominator and success/failure interpretation are unspecified, so do not treat it as a verified failure rate.

functions.name: list-payer-statuses
functions.description: List payer operational statuses, optionally selecting one of the documented status categories.

status.description: Optional status selection. Payer Up: active and running transactions; Payer Active: active without recent transactions; Payer Inactive: marked inactive; Payer Down: active with more failures in the past hour. Omit for all statuses.

FunctionInput_pverify_listpayerstatuses.description: Optional exact operational-status selection for the payer list.

id.description: Opaque pVerify payer code, matching the payer directory identifier when present there.

name.description: Provider's payer display name; omitted or null when supplied that way.

status.description: Provider's exact operational status text. Known values are Payer Up, Payer Active, Payer Inactive, and Payer Down; unknown future text is preserved. Omitted or null means unspecified.

items.description: One payer and its provider-reported operational status.
Payer operational-status records, optionally restricted to the selected status; empty when no records match.

FunctionOutput_pverify_listpayerstatuses.description: One complete provider page of payer operational statuses, with no continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this for current operational status, not directory capabilities; use `list-payers` for those. No payer identifier is needed. An optional status selects one documented category. Returns one complete provider page with no continuation. Payer Down means elevated transaction failures over the past hour, not a guarantee that every transaction fails.

functions.name: list-payers
functions.description: List current pVerify payers, their supported services, and any payer-specific instructions.

isActive.description: Whether the payer is marked active; not a guarantee of current transaction availability.

isDentalPayer.description: Provider's dental-payer flag; omitted or null means unspecified.

supportsClaims.description: Whether the payer supports claims; omitted or null means unspecified.

supportsEligibility.description: Whether the payer supports eligibility requests; omitted or null means unspecified.

functions.name: search-best-patient-match
functions.description: Submit patient demographics to obtain pVerify's single best matching patient, with at most one returned candidate.

ssn.description: Patient full SSN or last four digits, as supported by the selected demographic combination; sensitive text.

lastName.description: Patient family name, required for matching.

location.description: Practice location associated with the inquiry and its visibility.

firstName.description: Patient given name, used by most matching combinations.

phoneNumber.description: Optional patient telephone number as text.

referenceId.description: Your patient identifier, such as an MRN.

FunctionInput_pverify_searchbestpatientm.description: Patient demographics and practice location for a single best-match inquiry.

id.description: Opaque patient-matching inquiry ID for later retrieval.

ssn.description: Candidate SSN as returned, retaining masking or explicit null.

score.description: Provider match score, not a normalized identity probability.

street2.description: Address line two, retaining explicit null.

groupId.description: Opaque candidate group identifier; not asserted to be a stable patient ID.

middleName.description: Candidate middle name; explicit null retained.

items.description: The provider-selected top patient candidate, without an identity-certainty guarantee.
Zero or one top-ranked patient candidate, not proof of identity.

responseCode.description: Provider business response code as text.

patientsFound.description: Provider-reported patient count; not synthesized from array length.

requestGroupId.description: Opaque group identifier for the inquiry.

FunctionOutput_pverify_searchbestpatient.description: A patient-matching inquiry transaction and zero or one provider-selected candidate.

tags.instructions: Use when one top candidate is sufficient; use `search-patient-matches` when you need all candidates for review. Supply last name, practice location, and enough demographics for a supported matching combination, such as first name plus ZIP or state. Retain the inquiry id for `get-patient-matching-inquiry`. Matching creates a transaction and location can affect portal visibility; do not automatically repeat uncertain submissions.

functions.name: search-patient-matches
functions.description: Submit demographic search criteria and return all patient candidates in the provider's single matching response for review.

ssn.description: Sensitive SSN matching text; preserve provider-supported full or partial representation.

location.description: Practice location; limits portal visibility to authorized users of that location.

referenceId.description: Your patient identifier, such as MRN.

searchCriteriaId.description: Optional opaque provider search-criteria selector, when supplied by your configured workflow; omission uses provider selection.

FunctionInput_pverify_searchpatientmatch.description: Demographic criteria for one all-candidate patient matching inquiry.

id.description: Opaque matching inquiry transaction ID.

ssn.description: Returned SSN representation, retaining masking and explicit null.

score.description: Provider match score, not identity certainty.

street2.description: Address line two, retaining explicit null.

groupId.description: Opaque candidate group reference, not guaranteed a stable patient ID.

items.description: One patient candidate returned by the provider.
All candidates in this single provider response, preserving provider order; no invented continuation token.

responseCode.description: Provider business response code as text.

patientsFound.description: Provider-reported match count, not computed from this array.

FunctionOutput_pverify_searchpatientmatc.description: The matching inquiry and all candidates in its single response.

tags.instructions: Use when multiple potential matches must be reviewed; use `search-best-patient-match` for only the top candidate. Provide last name, location and identifying criteria. Location restricts portal visibility. This search creates an inquiry; retain id for later reference and avoid automatic replay after an uncertain outcome. The endpoint returns a single collection and does not document pagination.
